thoughts: Optimizing for technical density and architectural balance. I am shifting from a sidebar-based trigger system to a distributed 'NODES' layout that mirrors the center-aligned hero section. This creates a symmetrical, high-fidelity technical dashboard that rewards exploration. Descriptions are sharpened to focus on engineering metrics (0.5mm, 4.8x, 99.9%) to enhance the 'Precision Architecture' narrative without relying on marketing fluff.
